title: Binance Says It Has Finished Covering the $6.34 Billion Hack
description: Binance said it replaced all customer tokens drained in the October 29 hack with more than $6.34 billion of company funds, while the DOJ won authority to seize $1.2 billion of the stolen crypto.

title: Czech National Bank Completes Its First Tokenized Bond Tests
description: The Czech National Bank said it issued tokenized koruna bonds and completed transfer, trading and repo tests in October and November, with settlement almost instantaneous.

title: DeFi coalition asks Illinois court to declare the 0.2% digital asset tax unlawful
description: Eighteen crypto groups including a16z, Uniswap Labs and the DeFi Education Fund asked a Sangamon County court on Nov. 11 for leave to file a brief calling Illinois' 0.2% digital asset tax vague, discriminatory and unenforceable.

title: Kava Lend exploit borrows 55.2 million KAVA as Korean exchanges halt deposits
description: Attackers borrowed 55.2 million KAVA from Kava Lend through 127 loans on a dormant BUSD market, sold most for $2.09 million, and Upbit, Bithumb and Coinone suspended deposits.

title: Warsh to open San Francisco Fed forum on AI, jobs and inflation Monday
description: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh opens a Nov. 16 San Francisco conference on whether AI raises or lowers inflation, with three panels and a livestreamed fireside chat.
